name: harmony-tutor
description: Desktop app for harmonic analysis — Grand Staff editor with figured bass, Roman numerals, and voice leading.
author: Harmony Tutor

scripts.rebuild-corpus: tsx scripts/_build_corpus.ts && tsx scripts/extract-ornament-stats.ts && tsx scripts/buildDefaultStyleProfile.ts && tsx scripts/extract-progression-stats.ts
scripts.build: npm run audit:contracts && tsc && vite build
scripts.dev:united: cross-env APP_FLAVOR=united VITE_APP_FLAVOR=united VITE_PORT=5175 npm run electron:dev
scripts.dev:grandstaff: cross-env APP_FLAVOR=grandstaff VITE_APP_FLAVOR=grandstaff VITE_PORT=5173 npm run electron:dev
scripts.dev:guitar: cross-env APP_FLAVOR=guitar VITE_APP_FLAVOR=guitar VITE_PORT=5174 npm run electron:dev
scripts.electron:prod: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.pack: cross-env VITE_APP_FLAVOR=grandstaff npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: cross-env VITE_APP_FLAVOR=grandstaff npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: cross-env VITE_APP_FLAVOR=grandstaff npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: cross-env VITE_APP_FLAVOR=grandstaff npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.regress: tsx scripts/test-spelled-pitch.ts && tsx scripts/test-spelled-chord-engine.ts && tsx scripts/regression-check.ts
